name: Sandra
source:
Sandra is a hardworking person, so much that she tends to be very critical of her own work as an artist. Positive and reliable, you can always count on her when you're going through rough patches. Her empathetic nature is what has pushed her to try to cheer her co-worker Doug up. How will this relationship bloom? It's up to you!

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/rendez-doug]official profile[/url]]
